meta.title: Every Season — Vocabulary Set 2
meta.subject: English Vocabulary
meta.description: Vocabulary practice focusing on Week 10 words: season, spring, speckled, woven, crocuses, daffodils, lilacs, salamanders.

questions.question: There are four _______ in one year: spring, summer, autumn, and winter.
questions.explanation: A 'season' is one of the four periods of the year characterized by particular weather.

questions.question: 'Spring' is the season when the weather is very cold and trees lose all their leaves.
questions.explanation: False. Spring is the warm season when green grass grows and flowers open up.

questions.question: Which of these is a bright yellow spring flower mentioned in the story?
questions.explanation: Daffodils are yellow flowers that open up during the spring.

questions.question: A 'speckled' egg is plain white and has no markings at all.
questions.explanation: False. 'Speckled' means covered with small spots or marks.

questions.question: What are 'crocuses' in the context of spring?
questions.explanation: Crocuses are small early-spring flowers that pop up from the ground.

questions.question: Birds build _______ nests by crossing twigs and grass together.
questions.hint: Made by weaving threads or branches together.
questions.explanation: A woven nest is constructed by interlacing twigs, grass, and leaves.

questions.question: What is a 'salamander'?
options: A small bird that nests in trees
A small lizard-like animal that lives in damp places
questions.explanation: A salamander is a small amphibian that looks like a lizard and slithers under rocks.

questions.question: Sort these Week 10 words into Flowers or Other things:
questions.explanation: Crocuses, daffodils, and lilacs are spring flowers. Salamanders are animals, and woven is an adjective.

questions.question: Purple or white 'lilacs' are known for spreading a sweet, pleasant smell.
questions.explanation: True. Lilacs are highly fragrant purple or white spring flowers.

questions.question: Arrange the words to describe daffodils:
questions.explanation: Correct sentence: 'Daffodils are yellow flowers.' They open in spring.

questions.question: Which sentence uses the word 'woven' correctly?
options: The boy woven in the grass.
We wear a woven straw hat in summer.
questions.explanation: 'Woven' describes the straw hat (made by interlacing straw strands). This is the correct use.

questions.question: A lizard-like animal that slithers under rocks is a _______.
questions.hint: A damp-loving creature from the spring section.
questions.explanation: The text mentions salamanders slithering out from under mossy rocks.

questions.question: Arrange the words to show what fills nests:
questions.explanation: Correct sentence: 'Speckled eggs fill woven nests.' This describes a spring scene.

questions.question: Early flowers like crocuses and daffodils open after lilacs spread their sweet smell.
questions.explanation: False. Crocuses and daffodils open first, and then lilacs bloom and spread their smell later in spring.

questions.question: Which of the following describes the spring season?
options: A cold season with icicles and swirling snowflakes
A hot season to go barefoot and wear straw hats
A warm season to hold chicks and see flowers bloom
An autumn season to rake leaves and pick pumpkins
questions.explanation: Spring is characterized by warm weather, flower blooms, green grass, and holding baby animals like chicks.
